C1.requirement: stable-identifier evidence: evidence mapping with ticker == candidate symbol, non-empty listing exchange, non-empty issuer/vendor record

C2.requirement: fund inception strictly before the S0 start pushed back by warmup_sessions regular sessions of US_EQUITY_REGULAR_V1; unknown inception or out-of-table computation fails closed

C3.requirement: exactly one sane raw OHLCV bar per regular session over the declared common window; duplicates, non-session bars and insane bars rejected; gaps are returns, never fabricated bars

C4.requirement: a positive daily total-return index point for every regular session of the common window

C5.requirement: median daily dollar volume (raw close x raw volume) over the common window >= the predeclared floor

C6.requirement: zero unresolved ticker-change / liquidation / split / distribution event records

C7.requirement: every window session resolves a next regular session with a positive raw executable close (final session: calendar resolution only); fills never happen on the signal close

parameters.note: predeclared; changing them after scoring starts is a scientific-threshold change (PLAN 2)

eligibility_decided_by: the frozen RULE only; observed returns play no part; seed-list membership is not acceptance
current_survivor_limitation: COHORT LIMITATION (PLAN_stocks_free.md 3.1): the candidate seed list is a current-survivor list of long-lived US-listed ETFs. The frozen cohort is NOT survivorship-free: ETFs delisted before the evaluation window were never candidates. All inference is limited to the actual frozen ETF cohort; results may not be generalized to delisted ETFs, to the historical US stock market, or to all US equities.
loader_contract: research/stocks_free_v1/cohort.py CohortDataSource (typing.Protocol): identifier_evidence / inception_date / raw_bars / tr_index / unresolved_events; the A2 lane adapter implements it at integration
real_census_status: NOT_RUN_IN_THIS_LANE: this lane has no access to the A2 data lane; the real ACCEPTED/REJECTED census over the seed list is produced at integration once the A2 loader is joined. Synthetic goldens for every check pass in tests/stocks_free_v1/test_cohort_rule.py.
